storyboard.concept: Exquisite ruby jewellery set showcased with premium elegance

scenes.visual: Ruby and diamond jewellery set arranged elegantly on display surface - necklace, earrings and bracelet with deep red stones and sparkling diamonds in ornate settings
scenes.background: luxurious white silk fabric surface, soft golden light from above, warm ambient glow, shallow depth blurred background
scenes.vo: Kya baat hai, itni sundar ruby jewellery set

scenes.visual: Close-up of ruby necklace showing intricate diamond halo settings around each cushion-cut ruby stone, detailed metalwork and fine craftsmanship
scenes.background: polished marble surface, dramatic side lighting, deep shadows creating contrast, sophisticated ambiance
scenes.vo: Har ruby mein diamond ka glow

scenes.visual: Matching ruby earrings displayed prominently showing teardrop design with square ruby centers and dangling pear-shaped rubies
scenes.background: velvet jewelry display pad, soft museum lighting, elegant minimalist setting, pristine backdrop

scenes.visual: Complete ruby jewellery set arranged together in premium presentation, all pieces visible showing coordinated design and exceptional craftsmanship
scenes.background: premium jewelry box interior, soft LED lighting, luxurious satin lining, high-end retail ambiance

storyboard.notes: Premium showcase highlighting the ruby jewellery set's luxury appeal with warm Hinglish voiceover. Each scene reveals different aspects - overview, detailed craftsmanship, matching pieces, and final presentation. Varied camera movements and elegant lighting create aspirational mood without hands or models, focusing purely on product beauty.
